# Story 9.3: E2E test for consistent MM/DD/YYYY date format

Status: in-progress

## Story

As a user (Dave),
I want an end-to-end proof that table dates render as `MM/DD/YYYY`,
So that I can trust the format is consistent in real use on the screens where it was previously wrong.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A Playwright e2e spec loads Sold Positions with seeded data and asserts the Buy Date and Sell Date cells match the `MM/DD/YYYY` pattern (two-digit month, two-digit day, four-digit year) — not the short `M/d/yy` form.
2. The same or a sibling spec loads Open Positions and asserts the Ex-Date cell matches `MM/DD/YYYY`.
3. The spec runs on chromium alongside the existing e2e specs (`open-positions.spec.ts`, `dividend-deposits-modal.spec.ts`) with no pre-existing regression.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [x] Task 1: Add the e2e date-format spec (AC: #1, #2)
  - [x] 1.1 In a new spec under `apps/dms-material-e2e/src/`, load Sold Positions with seeded data and read the Buy Date / Sell Date cell text for a sampled row; assert it matches `/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/`.
  - [x] 1.2 Load Open Positions and assert the Ex-Date cell text matches the same `MM/DD/YYYY` pattern.
- [ ] Task 2: Verify no regression (AC: #3)
  - [ ] 2.1 Run the new spec plus `open-positions.spec.ts` and `dividend-deposits-modal.spec.ts` on chromium; all pass.

## Dev Notes

- This is the user-visible proof for Story 9.2's two format fixes. The two screens chosen (Sold Positions, Open Positions) are exactly the ones whose date columns were previously rendered via `'shortDate'`; dividend-deposits and global-universe already render `MM/DD/YYYY` and need no new assertion here.
- **Selector strategy:** target the date column's `<mat-cell>` via `[data-column]` (e.g. `[data-column="buy_date"]`, `[data-column="sell_date"]`, `[data-column="exDate"]`) within a `.dms-body-row`; read `innerText()` and assert against `/^\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4}$/`.
- **Seeding:** reuse the existing e2e seed/fixture approach used by `open-positions.spec.ts` / sold-positions specs; do not introduce new DB setup. Note the shared SQLite e2e DB accumulates rows across runs — filter to a known seeded row rather than assuming row count.

### Project Structure Notes

- Add: one new spec file under `apps/dms-material-e2e/src/`. No production code changes in this story.
- No conflict: additive e2e spec; it does not modify app source or existing specs.
